knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Work is held until the written release and an approved plan exist. A manager's pressure does not replace them.
The scheme covers provider registration and funding. Scene release is a separate matter.

practicalCriteria: From a fictional intake request, the learner writes the classification, the reason and the list of open authorities. Pass: all three are present and no work is assigned.
The learner drafts a hold notice that names at least three missing items. Pass: each missing item has a named responsible party.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed intake record for a fictional request
Hold notice reviewed by the supervisor
stopWorkCriteria: Written release is missing or unclear.
A party asks for work to start before scope is confirmed.
